description: Use this when an agent is about to pay a seller and needs a counterparty, price-fairness, and uptime screen. kind="intuitive" (default): verdict (do_not_pay/review/ok/unknown); kind="stats": figures; kind="pro": full bundle; kind="signals": combined screen. Unknown does not mean safe. Returns JSON `data` with attribution. Kinds: intuitive (5 sats or $0.003 USDC), stats (17 sats or $0.01 USDC), pro (33 sats or $0.02 USDC), signals (33 sats or $0.02 USDC). Pay: L402 (`l402_credential`), x402 (`x402_payment`), or `credit_token` (https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay, bittuitive://guide/pricing). Info only; not financial/legal advice; no warranty.

data_type.description: Catalog category, e.g. weather or btc.

price_usd.description: Listed USD price for fairness check.

x402_payment.description: Base64 x402 Base USDC payment (or params._meta['x402/payment']).
